description: Claude Code usage monitoring — tokens, costs, efficiency, tool usage, API performance, and productivity metrics via OpenTelemetry.

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Distinct sessions that had any activity within the selected time range.

panels.title: CLI vs user time
panels.description: % of active time spent on CLI processing (tool execution, AI responses) vs user interaction

panels.title: Tool rejection rate
panels.description: % of tool calls rejected — high rate means permission friction

panels.title: Cost by token type
panels.description: Cost breakdown by token type × model family, using public Anthropic list prices for Claude 4.x (Opus / Sonnet / Haiku). See the Pricing reference panel.

options.content:
### Pricing reference

USD per **1M tokens** — Anthropic **public list prices** for Claude 4.x.

| Family | Input | Output | Cache read | Cache write |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Opus   | \$15 | \$75 | \$1.50 | \$18.75 |
| Sonnet | \$3  | \$15 | \$0.30 | \$3.75  |
| Haiku  | \$1  | \$5  | \$0.10 | \$1.25  |

Model family is matched via regex on the `model` label (`claude-opus-4.*`, `claude-sonnet-4.*`, `claude-haiku-4.*`).

> **Note:** These panels show **list-price cost**, not what you are actually billed. For metered cost (from the API response `cost_usd` field), see panel **Cost over time** and the top-row **Est. cost** stat, which drive off `claude_code_cost_usage` directly. Discounts, prepaid credits, and enterprise agreements will cause list-price totals to diverge from the metered counter.

panels.title: Cost over time by token type
panels.description: Cost per token-type per model family over time, using list prices. Legend entries read as 'family token-type'.

panels.title: Context window growth
panels.description: Tracks cache_read_tokens per request — this IS the context window size. When it plateaus or grows large, start a new session.

panels.title: Cache hit ratio by model
panels.description: Per-model cache hit ratio: cacheRead / (cacheRead + input + cacheCreation). Highlights which models/workflows benefit most from Anthropic's prompt caching.

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage{type="cacheRead", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage{type=~"cacheRead|input|cacheCreation", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1) * 100

panels.title: Context:output ratio by model
panels.description: Effective input (input + cacheRead + cacheCreation) per output token, by model. Higher = heavy context for terse output (summarisation, lookup). Lower = concise prompts producing verbose output (code generation).

targets.expr: sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage{type=~"input|cacheRead|cacheCreation", model=~"$model"}[$__range])) / clamp_min(sum by (model) (increase(claude_code_token_usage{type="output", model=~"$model"}[$__range])), 1)

panels.title: Prompt activity by host
panels.description: User prompts per unit time, grouped by host — shows which machines are active.

panels.title: MCP tool usage by server

targets.expr: sum by (mcp_server_name) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", event_name="tool_result"} | tool_name="mcp_tool" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json mcp_server_name="mcp_server_name" [$__auto]))

panels.description: MCP tool invocations grouped by MCP server. Parses `mcp_server_name` out of the structured `tool_parameters` JSON via `line_format` + `json`.

panels.title: Cost per session
panels.description: Cumulative cost grouped by session_id over the selected range. Expensive sessions are usually worth investigating — often long conversations with tool loops or oversized context.

panels.title: API error rate
panels.description: Ratio of api_error events to api_request events, as a percentage. Spikes are worth correlating with model outages, rate-limit windows, or network issues. Thresholds: green <2%, yellow 2-5%, red >5%. For a real Grafana alert rule, see `grafana/provisioning/alerting/` (TODO if desired).

panels.title: Skill activations
panels.description: Count of `skill_activated` events by skill_name over the selected range. Useful for spotting which skills actually earn their keep.

panels.title: Top bash commands
panels.description: Top-N `Bash` tool invocations by first-word command, extracted from `tool_parameters.bash_command`. Repeat offenders often signal scripts worth pre-committing.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (bash_command) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", event_name="tool_result"} | tool_name="Bash" | line_format "{{.tool_parameters}}" | json bash_command="bash_command" [$__range])))

panels.title: File edit hotspots (top directory)
panels.description: Count of Edit/Write/MultiEdit tool invocations grouped by top-level directory path extracted from `tool_input.file_path`. Shows where Claude is actually changing code.

targets.expr: topk(20, sum by (top_dir) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", event_name="tool_result"} | tool_name=~"Edit|Write|MultiEdit" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json file_path="file_path" | line_format "{{.file_path}}" | regexp `^(?P<top_dir>(?:/[^/]+){1,3})` [$__range])))

panels.title: Subagent usage by type
panels.description: Count of `Agent` tool invocations grouped by `subagent_type` parsed from `tool_input`. Shows which specialised subagents are actually being used.

targets.expr: sum by (subagent_type) (count_over_time({service_name="claude-code", event_name="tool_result"} | tool_name="Agent" | line_format "{{.tool_input}}" | json subagent_type="subagent_type" [$__range]))

panels.title: Expensive sessions
panels.description: Top 20 sessions by cumulative cost within the selected range. $30+ is flagged red (your threshold from the interview). Cross-reference with the 'Recent prompts' logs panel to see what the session was doing.

panels.title: Loop suspects (top prompt × tool counts)
panels.description: Top (prompt_id, tool_name) pairs by tool-call count. A single prompt firing the same tool 15+ times usually means spinning — retry grep variants, re-read same file, etc. Values are color-scaled: yellow 10+, red 20+.

panels.title: Idle sessions (active hours vs prompts)
panels.description: Per-session 'user' active time (hours) — the time the CLI is waiting on you. High user time without proportional prompt activity means cache is accumulating rent without producing output. Sort descending to see worst offenders.

panels.title: Opus share of spend
panels.description: Share of total spend going to any claude-opus-* model. Stares back at you — when this stays near 100% week after week, it's your signal to try Sonnet/Haiku on a low-stakes task.

panels.title: Cost per API call
panels.description: Average `cost_usd` across api_request events. Trends up when context bloats (more cache-read tokens on every turn) or when prompts drift toward Opus-heavy work. Good leading indicator before the session-cost panel lights up red.

panels.title: Recent prompts
panels.description: User prompts as they arrive. Structured metadata exposes prompt text, session_id, prompt_length, and terminal_type. Parse with `| json` to filter on fields.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", event_name="user_prompt"} | json prompt="prompt", session_id="session_id", prompt_length="prompt_length" | line_format "[{{.session_id | regexReplaceAll \"^(.{8}).*\" \"$1\"}}] ({{.prompt_length}} chars) {{.prompt}}"

panels.title: Recent tool invocations
panels.description: Tool results as they arrive. Structured metadata includes tool_name, success, duration_ms, tool_input (bash commands, file paths), tool_parameters, tool_result_size_bytes, and decision_type.

targets.expr: {service_name="claude-code", event_name="tool_result"} | json tool_name="tool_name", success="success", duration_ms="duration_ms", tool_input="tool_input" | line_format "[{{.success}}] {{.tool_name}} ({{.duration_ms}}ms) {{.tool_input}}"
